info.title: F-Grade Corporate AI CRM API
info.description: Universal CRM retrieval backend for the F-Grade Corporate AI Agent.
info.x-copilot-studio-tool-description: Use this tool for any legitimate CRM question. Resolve the exact module, intent, date basis, filters, relationships, and output from the user's current message and CRM metadata. Send the complete natural-language question unchanged. Do not invent module names, field names, filters, relationships, or conversion logic. All standard and custom CRM modules must be discoverable from metadata. Conversion questions must remain natural language and be handled by the backend. Never emit a Leads field named Converted. For multi-module questions, retrieve each module separately and combine only verified results.
info.x-copilot-studio-input-policy: question is required and must contain the user's complete natural-language CRM request. Use conversation_id only for a true follow-up. Do not transform, summarize, or reinterpret the question. If the current message changes the module, metric, date range, scope, or output, rebuild the request from the current intent and discard incompatible prior context. Route Meetings or Events to the meeting/event module instead of Deals.

post.description: Resolves record, count, aggregate, grouped, and lead-conversion questions and executes the required filtered Zoho CRM query or queries.

200.description: Complete answer and requested CRM data returned by the backend for the user's question.

400.description: Invalid question, field, date, owner, or aggregate request.

502.description: Zoho CRM configuration, authentication, or query failure.

AssistantRequest.description: Natural-language CRM question. Send the complete user request in question.

question.description: The complete natural-language CRM question provided by the user.

conversation_id.description: Optional stable conversation identifier used to resolve natural-language follow-up questions.

response.description: Complete answer and requested CRM data returned by the backend for the user's question.
Complete answer explaining why the backend could not answer the user's question.
